def get_Inv_Count(arr):
    """Return the number of inversions in arr using merge sort."""
    if len(arr) < 2:
        return 0

    mid = len(arr) // 2
    left = arr[:mid]
    right = arr[mid:]

    inv_count = get_Inv_Count(left) + get_Inv_Count(right)

    i = j = k = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            arr[k] = left[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            arr[k] = right[j]
            inv_count += len(left) - i
            j += 1
        k += 1

    while i < len(left):
        arr[k] = left[i]
        i += 1
        k += 1

    while j < len(right):
        arr[k] = right[j]
        j += 1
        k += 1

    return inv_count
